verdict.rationale: Instinct documents linking Google Workspace, which gives it access to Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive. It indexes data from these external sources, and hands-on reports confirm it stores emails for later searches and uses them to produce summaries and act with context. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of Drive and Calendar content being searched and used in answers, connectors beyond Google Workspace (e.g., Microsoft 365, Dropbox), and in-depth first-party connector documentation.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: If you choose to link your Google Workspace to the Services, we receive access to your Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides and Google Tasks
You can delete all data indexed from external sources by visiting app.instinct.com/workspace.
the bot confirmed her emails were stored in plain text for later searches
The agent acted with context right away and picked up its first task before he asked for anything.
